 Hon'Ble Sameer Jain, J.

1.  Heard Sri Rakesh Chandra Tiwari, learned counsel for the applicant and Sri Imran Khan, learned AGA, for the State.
2. The instant application has been filed with the prayer to quash the impugned charge sheet dated 30.6.2020 as well as impugned notice under Section 82 Cr.P.C. issued by Additional District and Session Judge/Special Judge, Court No.4, Varanasi in Case No. 83 of 2020(State Vs. Lakshman Prasad and others) arising out of Case Crime No. 123 of 2010, under sections 409,
419,420,467,468,471, 201, 204 and 120B IPC and Section 13(1)(2) Prevention of Corruption Act,
Police Station Ghorawal, District Sonebhadra.
3.

At the very outset, learned counsel for the applicant submits that however, applicant challenged the charge sheet filed against him and process issued against him under Section 82 Cr.P.C. but applicant does not want to press the instant application and, therefore, the instant application may be dismissed as withdrawn.

4. He further submits that applicant is having some serious renal issue and this fact is evident from page 107 of the paper book and, therefore, court concerned may be directed that if applicant appears before the court concerned within two weeks and applies for bail then his application shall be decided expeditiously in accordance with law.
5.
Learned AGA is having no objection.

6. Considering the submissions made by applicant, the instant application stands dismissed as withdrawn and considering his ultrasound report dated 12.1.2025 it is directed that if applicant appears before the court concerned within two weeks and applies for bail then his application shall be decided by the court concerned, expeditiously, in accordance with law.

(Sameer Jain,J.) November 6, 2025 SKM  Hari Ram vs State Of U.P. And Another on 6 November, 2025 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/47145851/
